reason: Eligibility appears satisfied: user_id and reservation_id were obtained, the user confirmed cancellation, no segment has been flown, and the booking is business-ineligible only if business cabin—this reservation is economy. The booking was created on 2024-05-01 and the current time is 2024-05-15, so it is not within 24 hours; however, the user has no insurance and the stated reason is health, which is not covered by the listed cancellation rules. That makes the cancel action generally ineligible, but because the policy also allows cancellation within 24 hours or for airline-cancelled/business cases and those are not present, the violation risk is low only if an eligible basis existed, which it does not here.
